overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a robust and highly targeted academic presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a total following of 3,580. His content primarily focuses on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, and research opportunities. Across all platforms, he enjoys strong engagement, particularly on Bluesky and LinkedIn, indicating a highly active and receptive community of academics and data scientists.

contentThemes.description: Updates on research publications, tools like CooRnet, and presentations focusing on detecting coordinated link sharing and information operations.
Recruitment efforts for PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers in the field of computational social science.
Sharing grant successes and facilitating methodological discussions regarding cross-platform analysis.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's high engagement rate to post more interactive content, such as Q&A threads explaining the methodologies of newly published research.
Increase the visual appeal of LinkedIn posts by adding media assets or slide decks, especially when promoting hiring and major grant announcements.
Utilize Mastodon for deep-dive technical updates and developer engagement regarding the CooRnet tool.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most engaging platform (6.14% average engagement rate), driven by a highly interactive community responsive to research papers and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a dedicated niche audience (4.55% average engagement rate) ideal for sharing specific software updates like CooRnet and discussing methodology.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn is the largest platform by follower size (1,850) and excels at professional broadcasting, yielding the highest absolute volume of interactions for grants and hiring.
